title: Contraction map c: C_d(A) → C_{d+1}(A) (Bestvina–Savin)
body_html:
Contraction map $c : C_d(A) \to C_{d+1}(A)$ (Bestvina–Savin)

Fix a vertex $x \in A$. Following [BS, §2], there is a chain homotopy $c : C_d(A) \to C_{d+1}(A)$, expressed as $$c(E) = \sum_{E' \in [\![A]\!]_{d+1}} c(E, E')\, E',$$ satisfying:

  • (C1) $c_{-1}(1) = x$.
  • (C2) $c(E, E') \ne 0$ only if $E'$ is contained in the smallest subcomplex of $A$ containing the cone with vertex $x$ and base $E$.
  • (C3) $\partial c(E) + c(\partial E) = E$.

Existence and the explicit construction are reviewed in Bestvina–Savin contraction on a convex polyhedron complex (App C). (C3) is the chain-homotopy identity making $A$ acyclic with respect to the augmentation $C_\bullet(A) \to \mathbb{Z}_{x}$.

The Bestvina–Savin construction extends to $\BSigma_x$ once the $K$-condition is supplemented by [[node:building.K3_hypothesis|hypothesis (K3)]]; see [[node:building.contraction_extension_K3]].
